description: This is a Java source file defining the CounterFragment class, a UI component for displaying and animating a counter with drawable indicators in an Android application.

classes.name: CounterFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass managing a counter display with animated up/down arrow drawables.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, inflates layout, sets up drawables and counter, and starts animation.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and schedules a timed task to flip the arrow drawable periodically.

methods.name: setCounter (String)
methods.description: Sets the counter display to the specified string.

methods.name: setCounter (int)
methods.description: Converts an integer counter value to string and updates the display.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Cancels the animation timer when the fragment is detached.
